name.description: Substring of the place name, nominative case, e.g. 'Говерла' or 'Hoverla'.

candidates.description: Best matches first: by match_score, then elevation (desc), then node_id.

node_id.description: Graph node id to pass to planning tools.

name.description: Primary OSM name; null for an unnamed trail junction.

can_overnight.description: True for huts, camp sites and villages.

match_score.description: 1.0 exact name match (or no name filter), 0.8 name prefix, 0.5 substring.

reason.description: Why the list is empty (filters applied and name rules); null when candidates exist.

start_date.description: ISO date of day 1, 2000-01-01..2099-12-27; past dates are allowed.

end_node_id.description: End node_id, only if the user names where to finish (never a peak); equal to start for a loop; omit for the nearest village.

must_visit.description: 0-3 distinct node_ids to pass through; not the start or end.

fitness.description: Hiker fitness: day norm 6 / 8 / 10 h, pace factor 1.25 / 1.0 / 0.85.

overnight_mode.description: hut: nights at huts or villages; tent: also at camp sites.

day_constraints.description: Per-day segment bans; repeats are removed. Day must be within the hike.

day.description: Hike day, 1-based; must not exceed the number of days.

forbid.description: Segments this day must avoid: above_treeline (all above ~1500 m, includes exposed ridges) or exposed_ridge (open ridge only).

plan_id.description: p_ + 10 hex of the plan content hash; same content, same id.

applied_day_constraints.description: Normalized: no repeats, by day, then forbid.

end_name.description: Null for an unnamed trail junction.

path_node_ids.description: Every node of the day in walking order.

segment_ids.description: Trail segments of the day in walking order.

ascent_m.description: Total ascent in the walking direction, metres.

descent_m.description: Total descent in the walking direction, metres.

est_hours.description: Walking time (sum of per-segment minutes) / 60, 2 decimals.

limit_hours.description: Day limit: min(fitness norm, daylight minus 1 h), 2 decimals.

limit_kind.description: Which of the two set limit_hours.

max_ele_m.description: Highest point of the day's segments, metres.

above_treeline.description: True if any segment of the day is above the treeline.

exposed_ridge.description: True if any segment of the day is on an exposed ridge.

overnight_node_id.description: Where the night is spent; null on the last day.

forecast_city.description: Weather forecast city of the day's highest node.

from_utc.description: Sunrise at the day's start node, UTC, rounded down to the minute.

to_utc.description: Sunset at the day's start node, UTC, rounded up to the minute.

check_window.description: Daylight window to check the weather for; not a schedule.

est_hours.description: Sum of all days' minutes / 60, 2 decimals.

day_waypoints.description: Per day: start, the must_visit nodes chosen that day in walking order, end. Pass to validate_hike_plan to reproduce the same plan. Present when status='ok'.

days.description: REPEATED_SEGMENTS: days on which those segments are walked; DETOUR: days with constraints.

baseline_plan_id.description: DETOUR only: plan_id of the same request without day_constraints.

baseline_est_hours.description: DETOUR only: walking hours of that plan.

baseline_km.description: DETOUR only: distance of that plan.

warnings.description: Hints that do not affect validity. Present when status='ok'.

label.description: Human label of the node: its name, or 'unnamed <kind> near <nearest named node>, <elevation> m'. Use it instead of node ids when talking to the user.

reason.description: requested: end_node_id was given; nearest_village: end_node_id omitted, the village with the shortest whole hike; loop: end_node_id omitted, must_visit given and no village fits, back to the start.

finish.description: Where the hike ends and why. Present when status='ok'; tell the user.

reason_code.description: Why there is no plan. Present when status='infeasible'.

reason.description: Explanation for the model. Present when status='infeasible'.

feasible_days.description: Day counts 1-5 for which the same request has a plan. Present when status='infeasible'.
